name: CICAPT Phase2 IP-addressed packet-level exploratory baseline (v2)
status: FROZEN ALLOCATION POLICY FOR EXPLORATORY BASELINE; TRAINING DATA NOT MATERIALIZED
not_a_claim_of: ready-to-deploy Raspberry Pi window feature compatibility

raw_source.note: Raw file size checked against preflight. No full-file checksum computed; original file unchanged.

ip_scope_note: Original full preflight accepts valid IPv4 OR IPv6 addresses; this manifest counts IP-addressed candidates, not independently verified IPv4-only records.
label_policy: Use publisher-provided label as target; never include label, subLabel, subLabelCat, Caldera event candidate, raw IPs, or epoch ts in features.

eligibility_policy.excluded_record_type: Source IP=0, Destination IP=0, Protocol Type=0, ARP=1, IPv=0, label=0
eligibility_policy.evidence: Full Phase2 terminal check on 2026-10-20; all 74,995 zero-address records had this pattern.
eligibility_policy.method: Keep source rows untouched; skip these only for the IP-addressed baseline materialization.
eligibility_policy.warning: The non-IP fallback group in preflight was only for accounting; never use it as a real flow.

split_policy.unit: canonical bidirectional IP/port/protocol 5-tuple; groups may include both benign and attack observations
split_policy.attack_bearing_groups: Use explicit v2 positive-flow mapping (46 groups)
split_policy.benign_only_groups: Hash flow key using BLAKE2b digest_size=8 on J26-CS-336|CICAPT|flow-v1|<canonical_key>; train if fraction <0.70, validation if <0.85, else test
split_policy.limitation: Flow disjointness does not ensure session/campaign disjointness; validation attacks occur only Dec2; test covers 5 of 25 observed categories.
split_policy.use: Train and tune on train/validation only; defer opening test examples until choices are locked. Report test once and label it internal CICAPT holdout.

next: Implement streaming packet-level baseline preprocessing and train/validation pipeline. Confirm IPv4-only vs IPv6 presence before asserting an IPv4-only experiment. Do not treat dataset columns as verified 5/10/15/20-second gateway windows.
